properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 5:12PM MDT until October 22 at 11:15PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
FFWABQ

The National Weather Service in Albuquerque has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Sandoval County in north central New Mexico...

* Until 1115 PM MDT Thursday.

* At 512 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Up to 1.5 inches of rain have
fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Cuba.

This includes Highway 550 between Mile Markers 32 and 73.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly or mountainous terrain there are numerous low water
crossings which are potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 3:41PM MDT until October 22 at 6:45PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Kane County in southern Utah...
East Central Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 645 PM MDT.

* At 341 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms moving into
Zion National Park from the south. Up to 0.25 inches of rain have
fallen from previous showers over the last half hour. Additional
rainfall amounts up to 0.75 inches are possible across the park as
these thunderstorms move in. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of slot canyons, normally
dry washes, creeks and streams

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zion National Park and Springdale.
properties.instruction:
Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Stay away or be swept away. River banks and culverts can become
unstable and unsafe.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to slot canyons, normally dry washes, creeks and
streams which can become killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers
should avoid streams or creeks.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 22 at 2:26PM MST until October 22 at 8:30PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Paria River in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 830 PM MST /930 PM MDT/ Tonight.

* At 226 PM MST /326 PM MDT/, repeated heavy rainfall from
thunderstorms across the region have caused a nearly 6 foot rise on
the Paria River, with additional rises reported well upstream.
Levels are falling at Lees Ferry, but are expected to rise again
later this afternoon and evening. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Paria River.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Paria River.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lees Ferry and Vermilion Cliffs National Monument.

This includes the Colorado River near mile marker 0.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Lees Ferry Camp Site.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River and Paria River.
properties.instruction:
Get out of the Paria River slot canyon! Flood waters will continue to
flow down the Paria River.
